Name: TailingsHarvest
Title: Something That Grows
Summary: Sable's field keeps producing. Nobody can explain why. Bring back what comes out of it.
StartAnnouncement: A crawler has accepted agricultural work. We are contractually obliged to broadcast this and are exploring our options.
CompletionAnnouncement: Harvest complete. Viewers have been assured that the produce is not radioactive, which is a strange thing to have needed assuring.

Name: TailingsLights
Title: What Marguerite Saw
Summary: The elder has been counting the lights on the mountain for weeks. She wants somebody to go and look.

Objectives.Description: Reach the head of the Rocky Flats Extraction Shaft
